name: Patellar Tendon Partial Tear
definition: Partial disruption of the patellar tendon with preserved but painful extensor mechanism.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound or MRI defines tear extent.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Progressive rehabilitation when extensor mechanism is intact
amber: High-grade partial tears or failed conservative care require orthopedic review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Snayu tear phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Partial disruption of the patellar tendon with preserved but painful extensor mechanism.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
